title: Pills's brother Ninny Quacko
summary: Barnes describes Ninny, who left town long ago, and compares his playing and build with Pills's.

blocks.x: What about Pills' brother, Ninny Quacko? You remember Ninny?

He's out in California last year, and I believe he's alive out in Los Angeles.
Well, I'm surprised that one would read it. I wouldn't know him now if he'd walk upon me. He wouldn't know me.

Well, he was a heavier, heavier man in Pills. You know, he was much heavier than Pills. But they were all pretty much the same color. Did he play variety, Ninny?
